# Kaleidoscope Therapeutic Shampoo, Conditioner, Leave-In & Miracle Drops Set

## Cleanse Without Stripping

Kaleidoscope Therapeutic Detox Shampoo blends rosemary, ginger, and jojoba oil to cleanse hair thoroughly without stripping it. Its cool, stimulating formula lifts away buildup and helps restore the natural pH balance of hair and scalp, so your routine leaves hair feeling clean and refreshed.

## Restore Softness and Moisture

The Therapeutic Nourishing Conditioner, also infused with rosemary, ginger, and jojoba oil, revitalizes dry, damaged hair. Its nutrient-rich formula smooths and softens each strand, making hair easier to manage and helping it look visibly healthy.

## Nourish From the Scalp Up

Miracle Drops deliver essential oils directly to the scalp. Peppermint provides a cooling, tingling sensation, tea tree oil helps cleanse the scalp and combat dryness, and aloe extracts nourish hair follicles to help prevent breakage. The result is hair with a lightweight shine.

## Style With Lasting Moisture

The Miracle Drops Leave-In is a lightweight, moisture-rich formula that supports strong, healthy hair between washes. It adds hydration without weighing hair down.

## Build a Complete Routine

For best results, pair Miracle Drops with the Kaleidoscope Therapeutic Shampoo and Conditioner or the Moisture Silk line. Rated 4.5 stars by nearly 1,000 shoppers, this set makes it simple to care for your hair and scalp every day.

**Shop the Kaleidoscope Therapeutic Set today and start building a healthier hair care routine.**
